paragraphs: hey! my name is ezra, and i'm the developer of Paracosm. Paracosm is a website made for plural systems to log alters, track fronting, take notes, and stay organized — all without ever creating an account or trusting your data to someone else's server. everything runs entirely in your browser and stores data locally on your device. no signups, no logins, and nobody — not even me — can access your data other than you.
features: detailed alter profiles with names, pronouns, roles, proxy tags, colors, avatars, and custom fields
organize members into groups and subsystems — subsystems can even track their own independent front
build out a relationship map between members with a visual relationship graph
archive old alters or boards without losing their data
